css-clamp-generator.name: CSS clamp Generator
css-clamp-generator.description: Generate fluid font sizes between two viewport widths, preview the scale, and copy or download CSS locally.

meta.title: CSS clamp Generator
meta.description: Generate fluid font sizes between two viewport widths, preview the scale, and copy or download CSS locally.
meta.keywords: fluid typography, responsive font size, CSS clamp, rem, vw

cssClamp.hint: Viewport widths: integers from 1 to 100000. Font sizes: 0–10000 px; root size: 1–1000 px. Sizes accept up to 3 decimal places. Font sizes may increase, decrease or stay constant.
cssClamp.previewHint: The slider simulates the entered viewport and root font size. Large text is clipped within the preview.
cssClamp.emptyResult: Enter two viewport widths and font sizes, then generate CSS.
cssClamp.rules: Paste the declaration inside a CSS rule. Values stay within the two font-size bounds. rem output matches the entered sizes at the specified root size; changing the actual root size changes the rem bounds and intercept, while vw follows the viewport. Coefficients are rounded to 10 decimal places.
cssClamp.invalidWidth: Enter a whole viewport width from 1 to 100000 px.
cssClamp.invalidSize: Enter a font size from 0 to 10000 px with up to 3 decimal places.
cssClamp.invalidRoot: Enter a root font size from 1 to 1000 px with up to 3 decimal places.
cssClamp.viewportOrder: The end viewport width must be greater than the start width.
